what_is_open: It remains to construct, or to rule out, a finite district-compositional order-AMWN and ctf-calculus recursion that is sound and complete for every finite binary signed-monotone instance and whose every terminal local failure trace is uniformly compiled into two legal binary signed-isotone response-type SCMs with the same menu laws and different positive-denominator query values, without parity or multi-bit gadgets.
obstruction: The declared dependencies prove an exact response-atom normal form and a complete global semialgebraic oracle, but they provide no realizability-preserving local gluing theorem.  District factorization of each response-type atom does not by itself characterize which collections of district-cell probabilities arise from the shared private-and-edge exogenous product structure simultaneously across all regimes and counterfactual worlds.  The equal-menu constraints and query separation used by the global oracle are coupled polynomial conditions on whole-model exogenous masses.  No frozen result localizes those conditions to a terminal graphical obstruction or proves that signed-isotone threshold gadgets compose through arbitrary district recursion while preserving all menu equalities and the strict query separation.  Consequently neither a positive local completeness construction nor a negative impossibility theorem follows from the current primitives.
attempted: First, use the unique order-normal response-atom expansion as the state of a district recursion.  This supplies finite syntax and deletes structurally impossible order cells, but the recursion stalls because atomwise district factorization does not supply the missing joint realizability and gluing invariant.  Second, project the global quantifier-elimination failure certificate to districts and read it as a local failure trace.  This does not work uniformly: the witness profiles and product-simplex masses are chosen jointly to satisfy cross-regime menu equalities, and the certificate contains no canonical terminal district obstruction.  Third, replace the unrestricted converse gadgets by sign-normalized isotone threshold tables.  Such tables enforce each local order restriction, but no available composition lemma shows that arbitrary local gadget choices preserve the globally coupled menu equalities and unequal query cross-product.
partial_result:
For each \(E\in\left\{A_Q\cap B_Q,B_Q\right\}\), Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:order\text{-}normal\text{-}factorization}\) gives the unique finite identity
\[
 \mathbf 1_E
 =\sum_{t:e_E(t)=1}\prod_{D\in\mathcal D(G)}
   \mathbf 1_{\left\{(R_v)_{v\in D}=t_D\right\}},
\]
and every deleted order-inconsistent cell is null in every \(\mathfrak m\in\mathfrak M(G,M)\).  Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:finite\text{-}oracle\text{-}complete\text{-}mctfid}\) gives
\[
 \operatorname{GID}_{G,M,\mathcal Z}(Q)=1
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \mathsf{MCTFID}(G,M,\mathcal Z,Q)=F\in\mathcal R(p),
\]
with \(F(P_{\mathcal Z}(\mathfrak m))=\theta_Q(\mathfrak m)\) for every compatible model satisfying \(P_{\mathfrak m}(B_Q)>0\).  On the complementary branch its exact global algebraic certificate decodes into finite binary district-factorized signed-isotone models \(\mathfrak m_0\) and \(\mathfrak m_1\) such that
\[
 P_{\mathcal Z}(\mathfrak m_0)=P_{\mathcal Z}(\mathfrak m_1),\qquad
 P_{\mathfrak m_i}(B_Q)>0\ \ (i=0,1),\qquad
 \theta_Q(\mathfrak m_0)\ne\theta_Q(\mathfrak m_1).
\]
Thus the canonical local syntax, order-null deletions, semantic identification dichotomy, and finite signed-isotone global countermodels are established.  The sole residual is their realization by a terminating district-local graphical recursion with a uniform local-to-global failure compiler.
